question: From Table 2, what is the mean phenol removal rate of the four orthogonal runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g?
expect: (91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.57% (matches E1 of factor A in Table 3) (Table 2)
rendered:

The runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g are runs 1, 2, 3, and 4. 

Run 1: 91.95%
Run 2: 95.01%
Run 3: 88.94%
Run 4: 89.57%

The mean phenol removal rate is the average of these four removal rates:

(91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 89.57) / 4 = 91.82%
